::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Hyderabad-listed semiconductor design-services firm (founded 1999; 1,500+ engineers company-wide across India and the US). Its own DLI chip, the VIDYUT100 smart energy meter IC, taped out in April–June 2026 and completed initial bring-up in September 2026; commercial availability awaits qualification.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Turnkey ASIC and silicon-engineering services for global clients, and the VIDYUT100 smart energy meter IC.
